publicCopy.titleZh: TCS 为海得拉巴最高 1GW AI 园区取得 264 英亩土地
publicCopy.titleEn: TCS secures 264 acres for an AI campus of up to 1GW in Hyderabad
publicCopy.summaryZh: TCS 披露，HyperVault 已在 Telangana 取得 264 英亩土地，与合作伙伴预计投入最高 INR 700 billion（7000 亿印度卢比）建设和运营 AI 数据中心园区。最高 1GW 为分期规划，建设将随客户需求推进，并采用液冷设计。
publicCopy.summaryEn: TCS says HyperVault has secured 264 acres in Telangana. With partners, it expects to invest up to INR 700 billion in building and operating an AI data-center campus. The capacity of up to 1GW is a phased plan tied to customer demand, with liquid cooling in the design.

publicClaims.claim: TCS says HyperVault has secured 264 acres in Telangana and plans a phased AI data-center campus of up to 1GW tied to customer demand.

internalNotes: Primary source reviewed in the morning recovery; publication had not yet been read back from production.

publicCopy.titleZh: OpenAI 披露研究代理使用情况，区分自动化任务与独立研究能力
publicCopy.titleEn: OpenAI reports research-agent usage, distinguishing automated tasks from independent research
publicCopy.summaryZh: OpenAI 在研究加速报告中介绍，代理已能在研究员指导下处理定义清晰、持续数天的任务；公司同时强调，运行时长和代码提交量不能直接等同于科学产出。材料展示的是内部研究工作流的变化，而非完全自主研究已经实现。
publicCopy.summaryEn: OpenAI describes agents handling well-defined, multi-day tasks under researcher direction. It cautions that runtime and code submissions do not directly measure scientific output. The report documents changes in internal research workflows, not the achievement of fully autonomous research.

publicClaims.claim: OpenAI describes agents handling well-defined, multi-day tasks under researcher direction and cautions that runtime and code submissions do not directly measure scientific output.

internalNotes: Primary source reviewed in the morning recovery; no capacity or capex number inferred.

publicCopy.titleZh: Google 启动亚太 16 个环保 AI 项目的加速支持
publicCopy.titleEn: Google begins accelerator support for 16 environmental AI projects in APAC
publicCopy.summaryZh: Google DeepMind 公布 AI for the Planet 亚太加速器入选的 16 家组织，本周在新加坡开展集训，并提供为期 3 个月的 AI 技术与导师支持。项目涉及农业、生物多样性和碳排放等方向。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Google DeepMind named 16 organizations for its AI for the Planet APAC accelerator, starting a Singapore bootcamp this week and three months of AI technology and mentoring support. Projects span agriculture, biodiversity and carbon emissions.

publicClaims.claim: Google DeepMind named 16 organizations for its AI for the Planet APAC accelerator and will provide three months of AI technology and mentoring support.

internalNotes: Official Google page opened and checked; the program count is not treated as revenue, capex or data-center capacity.

publicCopy.titleZh: IT之家：Anthropic 版权和解金发放引发作者与出版方分配争议
publicCopy.titleEn: IT Home: Anthropic settlement payments spark disputes between authors and publishers
publicCopy.summaryZh: IT之家报道，Anthropic 版权和解金进入发放阶段，部分作者对出版方申领资格和分成比例提出异议。争议涉及权利已回归作者的作品及申领记录；这是和解款分配问题，并非新的模型采购或融资公告。
publicCopy.summaryEn: IT Home reports disputes over allocation as Anthropic's copyright settlement enters distribution. Some authors question publishers' eligibility and revenue shares, including claims for works whose rights have reverted. This concerns settlement proceeds, not a new model procurement or financing announcement.

publicClaims.claim: IT Home reports disputes over allocation as Anthropic's copyright settlement enters distribution; this is a settlement-proceeds dispute, not a new model procurement or financing announcement.

internalNotes: Single attributable T3 source; no public Anthropic response was found in the reviewed material.

publicCopy.titleZh: The Register：泰国暂停数据中心建设与审批，拟统一监管框架
publicCopy.titleEn: The Register: Thailand pauses data-center construction and approvals while developing a regulatory framework
publicCopy.summaryZh: The Register 报道，泰国相关委员会暂停数据中心建设与审批，并要求运营商和投资者提交现有及规划项目资料。报道提及对超过 2MW 的设施按工业项目监管及资源收费的讨论；这些监管安排仍属拟议措施。
publicCopy.summaryEn: The Register reports that a Thai committee paused data-center construction and approvals and requested information on existing and planned projects. Discussions include treating facilities above 2MW as industrial projects and introducing resource charges; those regulatory arrangements remain proposals.

publicClaims.claim: The Register reports a Thai committee paused data-center construction and approvals and requested project information; proposed treatment of facilities above 2MW remains unconfirmed.

internalNotes: Single attributable T3 source; official Thai committee or ministry record remains a follow-up.

publicCopy.titleZh: IT之家：利扬芯片终止收购重庆国芯微 100% 股权意向
publicCopy.titleEn: IT Home: Liyang terminates its proposed acquisition of 100% of Chongqing Guoxinwei
publicCopy.summaryZh: IT之家援引利扬芯片公告报道，公司认为交易条件尚未成熟，与重庆国芯微协商终止收购意向。双方于 9 月 4 日签署终止协议，并约定互不承担违约责任。
publicCopy.summaryEn: IT Home, citing Liyang's announcement, reports that the company and Chongqing Guoxinwei agreed to end the proposed acquisition because transaction conditions were not sufficiently mature. They signed a termination agreement on September 4, with neither party assuming breach liability.

publicClaims.claim: IT Home, citing Liyang's announcement, reports that Liyang and Chongqing Guoxinwei ended the proposed acquisition after signing a September 4 termination agreement.

internalNotes: Single attributable T3 source citing an issuer announcement; the issuer filing should be retained as the next upgrade path.

publicCopy.titleZh: CNBC 与 Fierce Network：NVIDIA 据报拟以 $12.9B 收购 Hugging Face
publicCopy.titleEn: CNBC and Fierce Network: NVIDIA reportedly targets a $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition
publicCopy.summaryZh: CNBC 与 Fierce Network 报道，NVIDIA 据报正推进以约 $12.9B 收购 Hugging Face 的交易，报道将其与开发者生态和 AI 基础设施战略联系起来。NVIDIA、Hugging Face 尚未在本轮来源中确认交易，金额和交割状态仍按媒体报道保留。
publicCopy.summaryEn: CNBC and Fierce Network report that NVIDIA is pursuing a roughly $12.9B acquisition of Hugging Face, linking the reported move to developer ecosystems and AI infrastructure strategy. Neither company confirmed the deal in the reviewed sources, so the value and closing status remain reported rather than official.

publicClaims.claim: CNBC and Fierce Network report a roughly $12.9B NVIDIA-Hugging Face acquisition; neither company confirmation nor closing has been established in the reviewed sources.

internalNotes: Two independent media groups were retained; the CNBC page was transport-blocked during a secondary check, while the scan preserved its public source metadata.

publicCopy.titleZh: EE Times：铠侠探索以闪存扩展 AI 工作负载内存
publicCopy.titleEn: EE Times: Kioxia explores flash-based memory expansion for AI workloads
publicCopy.summaryZh: EE Times 报道，铠侠正在探索面向 AI 工作负载的 Flash-for-DRAM 方案，以 CXL 连接的闪存承担内存扩展角色。报道未证明该方案已形成大规模部署、客户订单或对 DRAM 的直接替代。
publicCopy.summaryEn: EE Times reports that Kioxia is exploring a Flash-for-DRAM approach for AI workloads, using CXL-attached flash as a memory-expansion layer. The report does not establish broad deployment, customer orders or a direct replacement for DRAM.

publicClaims.claim: EE Times reports Kioxia is exploring CXL-attached flash for AI memory expansion; deployment and customer adoption remain unconfirmed.

internalNotes: Single T3 report; original article body was not independently opened through the secondary web reader, so only the bounded headline-level claim is published.

publicCopy.titleZh: IT之家援引韩媒：三星 4 纳米产能过半据报用于 HBM4 基础裸片
publicCopy.titleEn: IT Home, citing Korean media: More than half of Samsung's 4nm capacity reportedly serves HBM4 base dies
publicCopy.summaryZh: IT之家援引韩国媒体报道，三星晶圆代工 4 纳米产能中据报已有过半投入 HBM4 基础裸片生产。该报道描述的是行业渠道信息；三星尚未在本条来源中确认具体产能分配，不能据此推导实际出货或客户订单。
publicCopy.summaryEn: IT Home, citing Korean media, reports that more than half of Samsung Foundry's 4nm capacity is being allocated to HBM4 base-die production. The figure comes from industry sources; Samsung has not confirmed the allocation in the reviewed item, so it does not establish shipments or customer orders.

publicClaims.claim: IT Home, citing Korean media, reports that more than half of Samsung Foundry's 4nm capacity is allocated to HBM4 base dies; Samsung confirmation and shipment implications remain unestablished.

internalNotes: The original ZDNet Korea report was found and opened as a second discovery path, but the IT Home and ZDNet reports share the same reporting origin and count as one independence group.
